documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Consideration And Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results For The Quarter Ended 30Th June, 2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Pasupati Acrylon reported an 8.03% increase in revenue from operations to Rs. 62,143.18 Lakh and a 168.24% growth in profit after tax to Rs. 3,538.12 Lakh for FY 2024-25. The company successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant in March 2025, with a total spend of around Rs. 188 Crore.

guidance.claim: The company is exploring possibilities to increase its exports and is hopeful of achieving better exports in the coming years.
guidance.quote: The Company has exported to Dubai, Peru, Thailand, Morrocco, Tunisia, Nepal, Ukraine, Turkey, Algeria, Kenya, Brazil, Poland, Lebanon etc. and is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and it is hopeful to achieve better exports in the coming years.

guidance.claim: The performance of the CPP film segment is expected to improve in the coming years.
guidance.quote: During the year, the performance was marginally improved due to better sentiments in the market and it is expected to improve in the coming years.

guidance.claim: The company expects its initiatives to improve its financial performance, although forecasting exact productivity and profitability is difficult.
guidance.quote: However, it is difficult to forecast the productivity and profitability in quantifiable terms but the Company expects that the above initiatives are expected to improve the financial performance of the Company.

demand_outlook.claim: The company anticipates sustained demand growth across all of its segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Your Company anticipates sustained demand growth across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for acrylic fibers is expected to rise in the coming years, driven by the macroeconomic development of end-use sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for acrylic fibers is anticipated to rise in the coming years, particularly due to the macroeconomic development of end-use sectors which is supported by regional GDP and population growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The CPP films industry is projected to expand at a robust rate due to rising packaging requirements across sectors.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rising requirement for packaging across sectors, with traditional businesses preferring to package products, and the retail and e-commerce growing rapidly, the CPP films industry is projected to expand at a robust rate.

demand_outlook.claim: The overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at a 3.9% CAGR between 2023 and 2033.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rapid growth of the apparel & textile industry and increasing usage of acrylic fibres for making apparel, the overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 3.9% CAGR between 2023 and 2033.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to grow at a 4.2% CAGR from 2023 to 2033.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market for CPP packaging films is expected to reach US$ 8,742.2 Mn by 2033, growing at a 4.2% CAGR from 2023 to 2033.

demand_outlook.claim: Sales and production declined due to lower demand, but improved in the last quarter of FY 2023-24 due to better market sentiments.
demand_outlook.quote: During the year, the sale and production was declined due to lower demand but in the last quarter of FY 2023-24, it was improved due to better sentiments in the market and it is expected to improve in the coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand of acrylic fibre has risen, leading to increased production and sales compared to the previous year.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand of Acrylic Fibre has risen and the Company’s production and sales of Acrylic Fibre was 36,425 MT and 35,260 MT respectively as compared to production of 29,652 MT and sales of 30,918 MT during the previous year.

demand_outlook.claim: The global CPP film market is anticipated to rise at a considerable rate between 2022 and 2027.
demand_outlook.quote: The global CPP Film Market is anticipated to rise at a considerable rate during the forecast period, between 2022 and 2027.

demand_outlook.claim: The sale and production have seen good improvement from the previous year and are expected to improve more in the coming years.
demand_outlook.quote: The sale and production has seen good improvement from previous year and it is expected to improve more in the coming years but it is necessary to carefully watch other factors such as inflation, high energy prices etc.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and started commercial production in March 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March, 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has spent approximately Rs. 188 Crore on the ethanol project, funded by a Rs. 104 Crore term loan and internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: Company has spent around Rs. 188 Crore so far which includes Rs. 104 Crore of Term Loan and Balance amount out of internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost was initially assessed at Rs. 167 Crore but experienced overruns due to civil work.
capex_expansion.quote: The total project cost was assessed Rs. 167 Crore (excluding working capital margin) but the project was overrun due to Civil work.

capex_expansion.claim: A solar power system of 750 KW has been installed by the company.
capex_expansion.quote: Solar Power System of 750 KW has been installed.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has initiated steps to establish a grain-based Ethanol Project with a capacity of 150 KLPD, expected to start commercial production by September 2024.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the Ethanol Project is Rs. 167.58 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total Project cost is Rs. 167.58 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Indian Bank sanctioned a term loan of Rs. 108 Crores, with the remaining Rs. 59.58 Crores to be met from internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: Indian Bank had sanctioned Term Loan of Rs. 108 Crores and as per stipulations of sanction letter, the remaining project cost of Rs. 59.58 would be met out of the Company’s internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has already spent around Rs. 92.17 Crore on the project, including Rs. 44.08 Crores of Term Loan and the balance from internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: However, the Company has already spent around Rs. 92.17 Crore so far which includes Rs. 44.08 Crores of Term Loan and balance amount out of internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: Civil work is ongoing at the site and major orders for plant and machinery have been placed.
capex_expansion.quote: Civil work is going on at the site and major order for Plant & Machinery has been placed.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board of Directors approved setting up an ethanol project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD at a total project cost of Rs. 167.58 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, the Company is looking forward to diversify its business in Ethanol Product and accordingly, the Board of Directors, at its meeting held on May 18, 2022, accorded its approval to the Company to set-up Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD to align with GOI’s Ethanol Blending Programme (E20), subject to clearance and approvals from the concerned statutory authorities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has obtained environmental clearance for the proposed ethanol plant project.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has obtained Environment Clearance for the proposed project and company is under process to finalize various vendors/ suppliers / consultants for the projects and releasing advances to them as per contract out of its Internal Accruals.

margins_costs.claim: Key financial margins and return ratios improved due to an increase in profitability during the year.
margins_costs.quote: Operating Profit Margin, Net Profit Margin, Return on Capital Employed and Return on Net Worth are favourable due to increase in profitability during the year.

margins_costs.claim: The loss in the CPP segment declined due to better realization and a reduction in overheads.
margins_costs.quote: During the year under review, loss of CPP has been declined due to better realization and reduction in overheads.

margins_costs.claim: Cost optimization initiatives across alternate sourcing, standardization, and process improvements led to significant savings.
margins_costs.quote: Various cost optimisation driven by way of alternate sourcing, standardization, process improvements and operational efficiency improvements has led significant savings.

margins_costs.claim: Volatility in the prices of raw materials, energy, coal, and other key inputs has impacted global acrylic fiber consumption.
margins_costs.quote: Global Acrylic Fibre consumption is impacted due to volatility in prices of raw material, energy, coal and other key inputs.

margins_costs.claim: The raw material to produce the Company's products is crude derived.
margins_costs.quote: The raw material to produce the Company’s products is crude derived.

margins_costs.claim: Operating profit margin, net profit margin, and return on net worth declined due to relatively high production costs compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Operating Profit Margin, Net Profit Margin and Return on Net Worth are declined as cost of production was relatively high as compared to previous year.

margins_costs.claim: The CPP segment incurred a loss due to a persistent fall in selling prices caused by excessive production capacity in the market.
margins_costs.quote: Loss of CPP segment is incurred during the year caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

margins_costs.claim: Replacing the 8 MW impulse turbine with a reaction turbine is expected to save approximately Rs. 100.00 Lakh per year.
margins_costs.quote: Saving of approx. 1.00 Ton/hour steam i.e. saving per year = Rs. 100.00 Lakh

margins_costs.claim: Net profit during the year declined due to negative returns on the CPP segment caused by persistent falls in selling prices from excessive market production capacity.
margins_costs.quote: Net profit during the year declined due to negative return on CPP Segment caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed production capacity of 42,000 MT PA for acrylic products.
orders_capacity.quote: The production capacity to produce Acrylic products of the Company is 42,000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, the company produced 35,198 MT and sold 33,850 MT of acrylic products.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,198 MT and Sale of 33,850 MT, as against production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's production capacity for CPP film is 10,000 MT PA.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company’s production capacity to produce CPP film is 10000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: The production and sale of CPP film stood at 6,343 MT and 6,409 MT respectively during the year under review.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film was 6,343 MT and 6,409 MT respectively as against production of 6,463 MT and sale of 6,476 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company produced 790 KL and sold 440 KL of ethanol during the year under review.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of Ethanol was 790 KL and 440 KL respectively.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, the company recorded production of 31,534 MT and sales of 31,685 MT of Acrylic products.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT, as against production of 36,425 MT and Sale of 35,260 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The production capacity to produce acrylic products is 45,000 MT PA.
orders_capacity.quote: The production capacity to produce Acrylic products of the Company is 45,000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: The production capacity to produce CPP film is 10,000 MT PA.
orders_capacity.quote: The production capacity to produce CPP film is 10000 MT PA.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, has decided not to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the year ended 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-equity ratio and interest coverage ratio varied due to an increase in the term loan availed for the grain-based ethanol plant and the associated interest.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt-Equity Ratio and Interest Coverage Ratio were varied due to increase in Term Loan availed for Grain based Ethanol Plant and interest thereon.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board decided not to recommend any dividend for FY 2023-24 as internal accruals are being utilized to set up the Ethanol Plant.
capital_allocation.quote: As the Company’s internal accruals is being utilized to set-up Ethanol Plant, the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board decided not to transfer any amount to the Reserves for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, has decided not to transfer any amount to the Reserves for the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided to plough back earnings and not recommend a dividend for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors decided to plough back the earnings to strengthen the financials of the Company and not to recommend dividend for the year under review.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in crude prices due to geopolitical conflicts affects raw material prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile due to conflict in Israel-Hamas War & Russia-Ukraine War.

risks_headwinds.claim: Foreign exchange fluctuations have a bearing on the company's margins due to its dependence on imports.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, since the Company is dependent upon imports, the fluctuation in foreign exchange i.e. USD vs. INR has also a bearing on the margin of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Climatic vagaries and changes in government policies remain pressing challenges for the industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: One of the most pressing challenges that remain is climatic vagaries in this industry, and at times changes in government policies.

risks_headwinds.claim: The absence of increases in Minimum Selling Price adjustments poses threats to forward planning, capacity utilization, and return on invested capital.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, the continued absence of non-increase in Minimum Selling Price adjustments pose direct threats to forward planning, capacity utilisation, and return on invested capital

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has no control over the prices of ethanol products, which are determined by Oil Marketing Companies.
risks_headwinds.quote: The prices of ethanol products are determined by Oil Marketing Companies (“OMC”) and the Company has no control on the prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Key risks include geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions, subdued global economic conditions, government policy changes, intense competition, regulatory changes, and cyber security threats.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geo-political tensions including supply chain disruption, subdued global economic conditions, changes in government policies and trade sanctions and restrictions, intense competition from local and global players, regulatory changes and cyber security threats are key risks which expose the Company to potential challenges and uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: Volatility in USD and crude oil prices due to the Israel-Hamas and Russia-Ukraine wars may affect margins due to dependence on imported raw materials.
risks_headwinds.quote: Further, since the Company is dependent upon imported raw materials, movement in USD and increase in crude oil prices due to ongoing Israel-Hamas war and Russia-Ukraine war may affect the margin.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global economy is likely to be hit by inflation, high energy costs, logistics issues, and international trade costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Global economy is likely to be hit by inflation, continuing high energy cost, logistics issues and costs in international trade.

risks_headwinds.claim: Dumping of acrylic fibre by China, Thailand, and Belarus, along with foreign exchange fluctuations, present challenges to the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite various challenges such as volatility in crude prices and raw material prices, dumping of acrylic fibre by China, Thailand and Belarus, foreign exchange fluctuations, the Company is focused on improvement in its revenue and net profit.

risks_headwinds.claim: Crude prices remained volatile and witnessed a continued rise due to the Russia-Ukraine war.
risks_headwinds.quote: The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile and witnessed a continued rise due to Russia-Ukraine War.

risks_headwinds.claim: The CPP film market is highly competitive owing to the presence of multiple vendors.
risks_headwinds.quote: The CPP Film Market is highly competitive owing to the presence of multiple vendors in the market.

management_commitments.claim: The company successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and started commercial production in March 2025.
management_commitments.quote: The Company has successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March, 2025.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Satya Prakash Gupta is proposed to be re-appointed as Whole Time Director for a period of three consecutive years from May 29, 2024, to May 28, 2027.
management_commitments.quote: The appointment as Whole Time Director designated as Director – Operations for a period of three consecutive years w.e.f 29th May, 2024 to 28th May, 2027

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to establish a 150 KLPD grain-based ethanol plant adjoining its existing manufacturing unit in Thakurdwara.
management_commitments.quote: The Company has initiated steps to set up Ethanol Plant adjoining to its existing manufacturing unit – Thakurdwara, Dist. Moradabad (Uttar Pradesh).

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
